intro:
I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Sharjah, UAE, with hands-on experience building and deploying REST APIs, microservices, and full-stack web applications end-to-end — from database design to cloud deployment.

I'm proficient in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and FastAPI, with strong grounding in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, plus production DevOps practice (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git). I also bring applied AI/ML experience (TensorFlow, NLP, MLOps) and a builder's mindset for shipping AI-driven features in real systems.

experience.description: Built and shipped full-stack products remotely — from a real-time microcontroller IDE to the company website — with cloud deployment and CI/CD.
highlights: Built a full-stack, web-based microcontroller IDE (React, Node.js, Flask, Socket.IO) with real-time code execution and live developer feedback.
Deployed and containerized the app on a cloud VPS with Docker, Nginx HTTPS reverse proxy, and an automated CI/CD pipeline.
Designed and shipped the company website and reusable, responsive UI components with cross-device consistency.

experience.description: Developed backend services and document-processing pipelines, focusing on secure APIs and OCR automation for financial documents.
highlights: Developed RESTful APIs and backend services in Node.js with authentication, request validation, and secure data workflows.
Built OCR-based document processing pipelines to automate structured data extraction from scanned financial documents.
Integrated backend services with frontend applications and improved API performance through systematic debugging and testing.
